proposals.evidence: Turner’s first latta branch explicitly gives Awankari lattā clothes, Punjabi lattā rag, Kumaoni lātā/lattā/latā clothes and Hindi lattā tattered cloth. The Kathoriya and Haryanvi laṭ(t)ā responses match this cloth/rag family with regional retroflexion. The r-expanded lattara/latthara branches are not selected.
